messages:
carmen: Kicking off account + VNet scaffold for nz-east-edge (new region). Goal: GPU cluster onboarding for edge inference pilot. Constraints: very small public IP pool, no prod peering, default GPU quota = 0. Need runbook + handoff.

jia: thanks — can you list required cloud APIs and service accounts? I can bootstrap IAM and org policies.

carmen: minimal list: compute, networking, service-usage, cloudkms, iam. Service accounts: redwood-infra-ops, redwood-vpn-gw, redwood-bastion. We'll also need a shared-services project stub for logging/ops (regional).

matt: FYI quota request takes ~3 business days in this region. For GPUs we need to request both quota and specific GPU family allowances (A100 vs T4). Suggest starting with T4s for cost until we validate perf.

sofia: +1 on T4 for initial validation. Also: subnet sizing — ops wants /23 internal to allow pod autoscaling across cohorts, but NZ region has overlapping CIDR with our partner VPN. We should reserve a distinct /20 private block from our global pool.

carmen: noted. Proposed VNet snippet for terraform (very small example):
```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "edge_vpc" {
  name = "redwood-nz-east-edge-vpc"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "edge_internal" {
  name          = "edge-internal-0"
  ip_cidr_range = var.edge_internal_cidr # e.g. 10.40.0.0/20
  region        = var.region
  network       = google_compute_network.edge_vpc.id
}
```

matt: also add route for shared-services over VPC peering and a firewall rule to restrict SSH from bastion only.

raj: quick check — are we using Cloud NAT for egress or will workloads have external IPs? Cloud NAT preferred for security.

carmen: Cloud NAT yes. We'll allocate NAT IPs from reserved pool. Remember limited public IPs in this zone; prefer ephemeral NAT with a small set of reserved addresses.

jira-bot (system): created ticket INFRA-3479 to track quota requests and reserved IP allocation.

jia: I'll create the project and attach org policies (no external IPs by default, restrict service account impersonation). Planning to run terraform apply in a sandbox project first.

sofia: validation checklist (suggested):
- project created with billing enabled
- org policies applied
- VPC + subnets created with correct CIDRs
- cloud NAT configured and tested
- firewall rules locked down (bastion SSH / internal k8s ports only)
- GPU quota requested and approved
- sample nodepool provisioned with T4, run perf smoke test
- cross-region peering / routing test (shared-services)
- iam/service accounts provisioned and key rotation configured
- cost estimate doc uploaded to infra-runbook

matt: commands for quick checks:
```
gcloud compute networks subnets list --filter="region:(nz-east)"
gcloud compute addresses list --filter="region:(nz-east)"
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=REDWOOD-NZ-EAST
```

sre-bot: Running preflight validations...
sre-bot: VPC CIDR overlap check -> OK
sre-bot: Reserved IP availability -> 4 addresses free (warning: <8 threshold)
sre-bot: GPU quota status -> 0 GPUs in project (action: quota request needed)

carmen: thanks SRE-bot — @jia can you file quota request with cloud support and copy INFRA-3479? Also assign someone to monitor IP consumption during bootstrap.

jia: on it. I'll request T4 quota first (n1-standard + T4-specific), and request a small A100 trial for perf comparison.

sofia: cost note: T4 transient tests ~0.12 USD/hr, A100 reserved is expensive; recommend Dedicated reserved pool only after steady-state capacity is known. Add a cost line to the runbook with projected monthly spend for X nodes.

matt: handoff plan: once iam + network validated, tag eng-sre for k8s nodepool creation and for health checks. Oncall will run the smoke test and retention policy validation.

carmen: final assignments: @jia = project + quota + org policies (owner), @matt = firewall + routing + peering (owner), @sofia = runbook docs + cost estimate (owner), @raj = oncall handoff and smoke verification. I'll coordinate wrap-up next Wed.

deploy-bot: terraform plan completed in sandbox (apply pending).

raj: I can take the smoke tests Wednesday 10:00 local. Will verify GPU allocation, kube node readiness, model-serving can load a 1B param model and infer under latency SLO.

carmen: perfect. Adding checklist item: rollback plan for IP conflicts (document steps to remove peering and remap CIDRs).

sofia: I'll draft the rollback steps and add a snippet for peering removal: `gcloud compute networks peerings delete ...` and include troubleshooting notes.

matt: anything blocking from network side? if not I'll start the peering request after jia's project is ready.

jia: nothing blocking. starting requests now, will post updates in this thread.

carmen: thanks team — this thread will be the single source for the initial bring-up. Please keep replies short and paste outputs where helpful. :thumbsup:
